regime_context: The regime is low-real-yield engineering plus strategic re-industrialization, with a hawkish Fed staging credibility while the Treasury suppresses yields structurally and holds easing as post-midterm optionality. The consensus narrative treats the Fed's hawkishness as purely autonomous tightening, but revealed interest is an administration-aligned 'strong dollar while cutting' bridge that wants lower real yields without the optics of near-term cuts.
regime_context_zh: 当前政策体制是低实际利率工程叠加战略性再工业化：美联储以鹰派姿态建立可信度，财政部则在结构上压低收益率，并把宽松留作中期选举后的可选工具。市场共识把美联储的鹰派立场视为完全独立的紧缩，但揭示出的利益取向是行政当局主导的“强美元同时降息”桥接——既想要更低实际利率的结果，又不愿承担近期降息带来的通胀信号。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: Iran ceasefire collapse and US strikes re-prime the oil re-escalation premium; energy was the top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 and the rotation is re-energized. The administration benefits from an oil-linked haven bid that supports the strong-dollar bridge without needing Fed easing.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂与美军打击重新点燃油价上行风险溢价；能源是 2026 年一季度 ETF 流入最多的板块，轮动再次获得动能。行政当局从石油相关的避险买盘获益，这在不依赖美联储宽松的情况下支撑强美元桥接。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater: ceasefire collapsed as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday 7/8–11
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 (first in years) on the conflict
Re-escalation spike now realized, rotation re-primed by ceasefire collapse
theses.dissent: A rapid de-escalation or Hormuz transit normalization would deflate the premium quickly; headline-fragile basis noted in the rotation map.
theses.dissent_zh: 若局势迅速降级或霍尔木兹海峡通行恢复正常，溢价将迅速消退；轮动图中已注明该主题对新闻高度敏感。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date despite no de-escalation headline.
falsifier.text_zh: 在没有降级消息的情况下，XLE 在检查日前仍落后 SPY 5%。

theses.subject: ITA
theses.thesis: Defense spending is a structural NATO super-cycle independent of the Iran headline two-sidedness; the defense bid persists regardless of oil outcomes. Shipbuilding, missile defense and munitions have targeted high-confidence capital flows.
theses.thesis_zh: 防务开支是结构性北约超级周期，独立于伊朗局势的双向波动；无论油价如何，防务买盘都会持续。造船、导弹防御与弹药领域有定向的高置信度资本流入。
evidence: NATO / Defense theater: structural spending super-cycle, high confidence
Proxies ITA, XAR, PPA, SHLD flagged as targeted rotation
Defense bid persists regardless of oil outcomes per capital map
theses.dissent: Recent ITA overweight calls have missed twice (7/17 realized -0.104, 7/02 realized -0.108), suggesting crowded positioning or timing risk in the proxy.
theses.dissent_zh: 近期 ITA 超配判断已两次落空（7/17 实现 -0.104，7/02 实现 -0.108），表明该代理标的可能存在拥挤交易或择时风险。

falsifier.text: ITA lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date with no NATO budget reversal.
falsifier.text_zh: 在没有北约预算回撤的情况下，ITA 在检查日前仍落后 SPY 5%。

check.note: graded via correlated surrogate XLI (no local series for ITA)

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh holds a strict-inflation-mandate hawkish line and the market now prices >70% probability of a September hike; hot May PCE reinforces the inflation-first stance. Real yields have room to stay elevated until the post-midterm optionality window opens.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什坚持严格的通胀使命鹰派立场，市场目前定价 9 月加息概率超过 70%；偏热的 5 月 PCE 强化了通胀优先的姿态。在中期选举后的可选宽松窗口打开之前，实际收益率有维持高位的空间。
evidence: CME FedWatch >70% probability of Sept hike after Iran escalation
May PCE core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y, highest since Oct-2023
Warsh Sintra response: 'prices are too high', buried forward guidance
Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 meetings
theses.dissent: The June payrolls crack (+57k) is exactly the labor-weakness trigger that could force a data-driven September pivot, collapsing long yields.
theses.dissent_zh: 6 月非农新增仅 +57k 的疲弱数据正是可能迫使美联储在 9 月转向数据驱动宽松的触发因素，从而压低长期收益率。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date on a September hold or cut.
falsifier.text_zh: 在 9 月维持利率或降息的情景下，TLT 在检查日前仍跑赢 SPY 5%。

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: Gold sits in a $4,044–4,200 range with the strong-dollar bridge and hawkish Fed real-yield backdrop capping upside. The administration's revealed interest is lower real yields without dollar weakness, which suppresses the gold tail unless a genuine Mar-a-Lago turn materializes (low odds, theory only).
theses.thesis_zh: 黄金在 4044–4200 美元区间运行，强美元桥接与美联储鹰派实际利率背景限制了上行空间。行政当局揭示出的利益是在不削弱美元的情况下降低实际利率，这压制了黄金的尾部行情，除非出现真正的海湖庄园转向（低概率，仅属理论）。
evidence: Gold trading $4,044–4,200 range, DXY ~100.9 well off 13-mo high
Dollar/debt theater: Mar-a-Lago turn labeled THEORY, low odds, tail to watch not own
Real 10y at 2.29%, gold < $4,000 in the hawkish staging phase
theses.dissent: A genuine Mar-a-Lago dollar-weakening turn or a dovish pivot on labor weakness would flip gold to a structural long.
theses.dissent_zh: 若出现真正的海湖庄园式美元贬值转向，或因就业疲弱触发鸽派转向，黄金将转为结构性多头。

falsifier.text: GLD breaches its 2-month high on a sustained dollar decline before the check-by date.
falsifier.text_zh: 在美元持续走弱的背景下，GLD 在检查日前突破两个月高点。
